preconditions.description: The number of vertices V is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: adj is a list of lists where each sublist contains integers representing the adjacency list of a vertex
preconditions.description: The adjacency list adj represents an undirected graph with V vertices.

postconditions.description: The result is an empty list or a list containing -1 if there are no articulation points.

postconditions.expression: all(v in result for v in articulation_points)
postconditions.description: The result contains all the articulation points of the graph in sorted order.
